known.title: Keep required acceptance findings open across review rounds
Apply acceptance classification to reused reviews
Follow-up: Include required acceptance findings in worker repair briefs

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A worker makes another repair after a below-bar Not done blocks the first review. The new flag does not prevent `_settled()` (review.py:641–646) from marking that finding as `known: below the bar`. When the next review repeats it, review.py:936–940 automatically carries a dismissal, which `blocking()` honors despite `required_done_when`. Close and the merge check therefore pass unmet acceptance without owner acceptance. Exclude required acceptance findings from automatic below-bar settlement.
findings.title: Keep required acceptance findings open across review rounds

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - An existing client upgrades Forge with an open branch whose saved review contains a below-bar Not done on its own acceptance. Older reviews lack `required_done_when`, and `_bound_findings()` runs only during a new review (review.py:935). Close can reuse the saved review when its fingerprint still matches (close.py:250–272); neither reuse nor the merge check reconstructs the flag. Both consequently continue treating the unmet acceptance as non-blocking. Classify saved findings before trusting them under the new gate. The earlier-adopted test starts a new fix after upgrading, so it misses this path.
findings.title: Apply acceptance classification to reused reviews

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
After a required Not done blocks close because of this override, the next `forge work` still selects findings using only `score.holds()` (worker.py:475–476). Below-bar, rare-case and light-review acceptance blockers are therefore omitted from the worker's Open serious findings, even though they now prevent merging. Use the same blocking classification when preparing the repair brief so the worker receives the finding and its evidence.
findings.title: Follow-up: Include required acceptance findings in worker repair briefs

stop.reason: The owner chose one more round on 22 Oct: close all three gaps

why: Close lists P1 findings, including a Not done on the fix's own Done-when, and then says Review: clean without saying that these findings do not block, so the agent merges unmet work without knowing (issue #927).
